description.value: <@eb.key>Can only be blocked by units of the same attribute</>. <@eb.danger>Explodes</> upon being defeated, touching an opposite attribute ally will trigger a <@eb.danger>more violent explosion</>.
A majestic Ink Spirit. Since it doesn't move much, it's often taken for a decorative feature. <@eb.key>Can draw enemies to attack it</>, unfathomably tough.
